t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Each round the gnome that gives the most mushrooms changes, repeatedly picking the same type of gnome causes the mushrooms it gives to lessen after each consecutive pick.The best way to find the most optimal strategy is to pay full attention throughout each round.

vb_textbox.text: Each round, identify the colours of gnomes to avoid.There didn't seem to be any height/pattern significance.Use rounds that have a 1X multiplier to experiment/testOn 5x multiplier rounds use what you've figured out. The highest paying gnomes are changed each round. The participant before me said that gnomes pay lessif you consecutively choose them but I didn't notice that. Best of luck, if it gets tiresome going 50/50 is always valid.
